scope: Scientific AI code-based figures 2–12; code inspected for each, new renderings visually inspected only for Figures 2 and 3.

scoring.scientific_validity: dataset provenance, actual execution, output arithmetic, labeling
scoring.informativeness: clear hypothesis, quantitative signals, comparison utility, no redundant panels
scoring.aesthetics: white background, premium restrained palette, legible typography, axes/units/caption matching, balanced arrangement

figures.problem: Redundant time-series panels and cramped legend
figures.action: Redesigned 3-panel scientific figure from 309 real annual sunspot observations and saved 59 held-out model predictions

figures.problem: Generic F1..F8 labels; oversized ROC with little discriminative information; uneven whitespace
figures.action: Four panels with named biomedical variables and measured held-out confusion matrix; 569 WDBC cases

figures.problem: Generic provenance DAG uses illustrative file names and entities, no empirical data
figures.action: Retain only as explicitly labeled provenance schematic; verify semantics, arrows, caption and legibility

figures.problem: Randomly placed colored nuclei depict tissue; cannot be presented as authentic histology observations
figures.action: Replace image-bearing observational panels with actual cited pathology slides if manuscript represents them as data; conceptual pipeline must be explicitly identified

figures.problem: Code references Drug Repurposing Hub chemical structures and published Stokes MIC measurements
figures.action: Verify exact chemical structures, MIC citations, numerical provenance and actual figure against code

figures.problem: Multi-modal oncology graph includes dataset names but explicitly warns against unpaired cohorts
figures.action: Check caption does not suggest patient-level pairing not established by data

figures.problem: Source loads WDBC dataset and executes model comparisons; output and figure assets not verified in this pass
figures.action: Recompute metrics from held-out predictions and inspect axes/uncertainty/sample sizes

figures.problem: Digital-twin state-space diagram includes modeled density-like decoration
figures.action: Label as schematic, never observed density; verify symbols and captions

figures.problem: PINN workflow diagram uses random coordinates to draw point-cloud markers
figures.action: Do not present random point markers as measured observations; replace with real measured sample geometry or explicit schematic symbols

figures.problem: PINN is trained on an analytical PDE with randomly sampled collocation points and exact synthetic solution, not actual observed scientific measurements
figures.action: Replace empirical result with observation-grounded PDE study, or remove from empirical evidence and clearly label analytic validation

figures.problem: Retinal image/OCT pipeline graph is schematic; no real image evidence in its generator
figures.action: If application/case study requires outputs, add real fundus/OCT images and measured inference; keep schematic distinguishable
